title: Signed contracts and reports in the portal

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: After a client signs, their paperwork stays in their portal. Here is where they find it.

steps.caption: The client's portal
steps.narration: This is a client's screen. Tunde Oyelaran, in Albany, is signed in to his portal.

steps.caption: What he signed
steps.narration: Every estimate he approved is listed, with who signed it, when, and its value.

steps.caption: Open the contract
steps.narration: Choosing the name opens the signed document itself.

steps.caption: Measurement reports
steps.narration: Next in the menu is Measurement reports.

steps.caption: His property's report
steps.narration: It holds the measurement report for his property, with its date and roof size.

steps.caption: 3D model and PDF
steps.narration: From here he can open the 3D model, or the measurement PDF.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Estimates keeps every estimate you sent him, with its status.

steps.caption: Invoices and receipts
steps.narration: And invoices and receipts will collect here, once you send one.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, you can check any client's portal with See what the client sees.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: That button is on each client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: Where clients find signed contracts and reports | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: What a client sees in their ConstructHUB CRM portal after they sign: the signed contract, the measurement report for their property with its PDF and 3D model, and every estimate and invoice you sent. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
